summary: A growing three branch Doha dental group appears to lose bookings to a WhatsApp only path, empty doctor profiles and conflicting claims.

findings.problem: The header Book Online button appears to go to WhatsApp while the FAQ points to an online booking form, and the form appears to collect a date but no time slot.
findings.cost: Patients get mixed instructions and drop off.
findings.fix: One booking path with date and time selection.

findings.problem: The booking pop up appears to show Doctor Name: - and Specialization: - as unfilled placeholders, and several doctor profile pages appear to be empty templates.
findings.cost: Placeholder text and empty profiles reduce trust.

findings.problem: The site appears to say A Decade Of Trusted Excellence and also 6+ Years Experience, and the offers appear to show no prices.
findings.cost: Contradictions and missing prices weaken proof.
findings.fix: One accurate history line and priced offers.

findings.problem: No opening hours appear, phone links appear to contain spaces, and doctor names appear spelled differently in reviews.
findings.cost: Patients cannot confirm when to call, and links may fail to dial.
findings.fix: Visible hours, clean tel links and consistent names.

redesign: Hours, priced offers and clean links.
